title: Subgroups of hyperbolic groups, finiteness properties and complex hyperbolic lattices
abstract: We prove that in a cocompact complex hyperbolic arithmetic lattice $Î< {\rm PU}(m,1)$ of the simplest type, deep enough finite index subgroups admit plenty of homomorphisms to $\mathbb{Z}$ with kernel of type $\mathscr{F}_{m-1}$ but not of type $\mathscr{F}_{m}$. This provides many finitely presented non-hyperbolic subgroups of hyperbolic groups and answers an old question of Brady. Our method also yields a proof of a special case of Singer's conjecture for aspherical KÃ¤hler manifolds.
